models.setupConfig: The current configuration state of Artifact Engine, including the artifacts folder location, API key status, and automation installation state.
models.setupSteps: The wizard steps that guide users through initial setup, each with a title, description, and completion status.
models.repositories: Git repositories the user can connect for automatic commit tracking via post-commit hooks.
models.workflows: Configured automations that run in the background to capture artifacts without user intervention.

relationships: SetupConfig tracks the overall state of the setup wizard
Each SetupStep represents one stage of the configuration process
Repositories are added during Step 4 and generate Artifacts via git hooks
Workflows are created when automations are installed (screenshot capture, git hooks)

setupSteps.title: Artifacts Folder
setupSteps.description: Choose where your artifacts will be stored. This folder will contain your year/week/category structure.

setupSteps.title: API Key
setupSteps.description: Enter your Mastra API key to enable AI-powered artifact analysis and contextualization.

setupSteps.title: Screenshot Automation
setupSteps.description: Install the screenshot capture automation. Press a keyboard shortcut to capture and analyze your screen.

setupSteps.title: Git Repositories
setupSteps.description: Select repositories to track. Commits will be automatically captured and summarized.

workflows.name: Screenshot Capture
workflows.description: Captures screen via keyboard shortcut, analyzes with AI, and files to appropriate category.

workflows.name: Git Commit Hook
workflows.description: Automatically captures and summarizes commits from connected repositories.
